title.en: Six in 10 Neets have never had a job, says Alan Milburn, as he warns of ‘generational faultline’ – UK politics live
title.zh: 艾伦·米尔本警告“代际断层线”，称六成“尼特族”从未就业

summary.en: A government-commissioned report in the UK highlights that six out of ten young people not in employment, education, or training (NEETs) have never held a job. The report warns of a "generational faultline" and states that there is currently "neither a system nor a plan to deal with it."
summary.zh: 英国一份政府委托的报告指出，六成未就业、未受教育或未受培训（NEETs）的年轻人从未有过工作。该报告警告存在“代际断层线”，并表示目前“既没有系统也没有计划来解决这个问题”。

body.en: Government-commissioned report on young people not in employment, education or training warns ‘we have neither a system or a plan to deal with it’ Young people in the UK: how has the search for work been for you? Pat McFadden , the work and pensions secretary, is introducing Alan Milburn. He says Milburn’s report is “really important and powerful”. I could see in the first few weeks after being appointed as the secretary of state what was happening, both in human and in financial terms, [in terms of youth unemployment]. And I knew that we had to get properly under the bonnet of this problem, because there’s a lot more thing than one thing happening here … Continue reading...
body.zh: 政府委托的关于未就业、未接受教育或未培训的年轻人的报告警告说，“我们既没有系统也没有计划来应对这一问题” 英国年轻人：您找工作的情况如何？工作和养老金大臣帕特·麦克法登正在介绍艾伦·米尔本。他说米尔本的报告“非常重要且有力”。在被任命为国务卿后的最初几周内，我可以看到在人力和财务方面（在青年失业方面）正在发生的事情。我知道我们必须正确地解决这个问题，因为这里发生的事情远不止一件事……继续阅读……

reflection.en: This report highlights a profound societal challenge when a significant portion of young people lack clear pathways for employment or purpose. Proverbs 29:18 reminds us that without a guiding vision, people can lose direction and society may drift. It calls for thoughtful leadership and collective effort to create opportunities and a hopeful future for...
reflection.zh: 这份报告揭示了一个深刻的社会挑战，即当很大一部分年轻人缺乏明确的就业或人生方向时。箴言29:18提醒我们，没有先见之明，民就放肆，社会可能失去方向。这呼吁有远见的领导和集体的努力，为每一代人创造机会和充满希望的未来。

verse.textEn: Where there is no revelation, people cast off restraint; but blessed is the one who heeds wisdom's instruction.
verse.textZh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。

title.en: Middle East crisis live: Iran says Trump’s threats to ‘blow up’ Oman ‘dangerous and bullying’
title.zh: 中东危机实时报道：伊朗称特朗普“炸毁”阿曼的威胁“危险且霸凌”

summary.en: Iran has condemned US President Trump's threats against Oman as "dangerous and bullying," following his remarks that the ally would be at risk if it did not "behave." Meanwhile, Hezbollah has claimed responsibility for numerous drone and rocket attacks targeting Israeli troops in southern Lebanon and northern Israel.
summary.zh: 伊朗谴责美国总统特朗普对阿曼的威胁是“危险和霸凌”，此前特朗普表示，如果该盟友不“表现得像其他人一样”，它将面临风险。与此同时，真主党声称对针对以色列在黎巴嫩南部和以色列北部的军队的数十次无人机和火箭袭击负责。

body.en: US president said ally would be at risk if it did not ‘behave just like everybody else’ Hezbollah has claimed dozens of drone and rocket attacks that it said targeted Israeli troops in southern Lebanon and northern Israel. The group said it launched several attacks on Israeli soldiers and tanks that crossed the Litani river into the town of Zawtar al-Sharqiyah near Nabatieh, as close-range fighting continues. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国总统表示，如果它不“像其他人一样行事”，真主党将面临数十起无人机和火箭袭击，并称这些袭击针对的是黎巴嫩南部和以色列北部的以色列军队。该组织表示，随着近距离战斗的继续，他们对跨过利塔尼河进入纳巴蒂耶附近的扎塔尔沙尔基亚镇的以色列士兵和坦克发动了多次袭击。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The escalating rhetoric and military actions reported in the Middle East highlight the perilous path of violence. Jesus' words remind us that resorting to force often perpetuates a cycle where all involved ultimately suffer. In times of heightened tension, seeking paths of de-escalation and peace becomes paramount.
reflection.zh: 中东地区报道的言辞升级和军事行动，凸显了暴力之路的危险。耶稣的话语提醒我们，诉诸武力往往会使所有卷入其中的人最终受苦。在紧张局势加剧之时，寻求降级与和平的道路变得至关重要。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Kaja Kallas warns against walking into Russian ‘trap’ as EU ministers meet for talks – Europe live
title.zh: 卡娅·卡拉斯警告欧盟部长会议勿入俄罗斯“陷阱”——欧洲直播

summary.en: EU chief diplomat Kaja Kallas has warned against falling into a Russian “trap” during ongoing talks, emphasizing the need for strategic focus over personality-driven discussions. Meanwhile, Hungary’s Magyar expressed a more optimistic view regarding the negotiations.
summary.zh: 欧盟首席外交官卡娅·卡拉斯警告在正在进行的会谈中不要落入俄罗斯的“陷阱”，强调需要关注战略而非个人因素。与此同时，匈牙利的马扎尔对谈判表达了更为乐观的看法。

body.en: EU chief diplomat says ‘not much happening’ in talks as she cautions against focus on personalities rather than strategy Meanwhile, Hungary’s Magyar hits a bit more upbeat tone in his latest post on Facebook, saying that while there are still some issues that need to be resolved, the two sides managed to agree a deal on “many important questions.” In a Facebook video, he takes viewers into a meeting room in Brussels from which he is working on ironing out the final details. “I will obviously not anticipate or prejudge what will be the outcome of that meeting, but a series of meetings has been taking place, as you know, between the teams on both sides to make as much progress as possible. … Let’s see what comes out of it. It’s not much more time to wait. We give it another day, and we should know more in terms of how far have we managed to get on both sides.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 欧盟首席外交官表示，谈判中“没有发生太多事情”，她警告不要关注个性而不是战略。与此同时，匈牙利的马扎尔在脸书上的最新帖子中语气更加乐观，称虽然仍有一些问题需要解决，但双方设法就“许多重要问题”达成协议。在 Facebook 的一段视频中，他将观众带入布鲁塞尔的一间会议室，他正在那里敲定最终的细节。 “我显然不会预测或预先判断那次会议的结果，但正如你所知，双方团队之间已经举行了一系列会议，以取得尽可能多的进展。……让我们看看会产生什么结果。已经没有太多时间等待了。我们再等一天，我们应该更多地了解双方已经取得了多大的进展。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: International diplomacy often involves complex challenges and potential pitfalls, requiring careful thought and strategic planning. As leaders gather for talks, the wisdom to discern true intentions and forge a unified path is crucial for the safety and well-being of nations.
reflection.zh: 国际外交常涉及复杂的挑战和潜在的陷阱，需要深思熟虑和战略规划。当各国领导人齐聚会谈时，辨明真实意图并形成统一道路的智慧，对国家的安全和福祉至关重要。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Wild weather unleashes thunderstorms across south-east Australia, triggering flash flooding
title.zh: 恶劣天气在澳大利亚东南部引发雷暴和洪水

summary.en: Wild weather, including thunderstorms and flash flooding, has caused chaos across parts of south-east Australia, affecting Queensland, NSW, and Tasmania. Heavy rainfall warnings were issued for Friday, with conditions more typical of summer than late autumn.

verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Mount Everest climber smashes 23-year record for fastest ever summit
title.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰登山者打破23年最快登顶纪录

summary.en: American climber Tyler Andrews broke the previous, long-standing record by just over an hour.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
US climber Tyler Andrews set a new speed record using supplementary oxygen on Mount Everest on Thursday, his team told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency, summiting the world's highest peak an hour faster than anyone before.

Andrews, 36, climbed the 8,849-metre peak in just 9 hours and 55 minutes, smashing the record of 10 hours and 56 minutes held since 2003 by Nepali climber Lhakpa Gelu Sherpa.

Andrews summited Everest just before dawn local time on Thursday, according to posts on his Instagram, which included live GPS tracking of his route.

"He reached Everest's peak in just 9 hours 55 minutes," team leader Dawa Steven Sherpa of Asian Trekking told AFP.

The Asian Trekking team said that Andrews completed a solo climb, during which guides provided supplementary oxygen, food and water while tracking his ascent.

He had initially tried to break the 22 hours and 29 minutes speed record to climb Everest without supplementary oxygen earlier in May, but had to turn back.

Andrews, who said he is a cancer survivor, is raising funds to support youth athletes who lack access to coaching and equipment in Ecuador and Nepal.

Andrews completes his summit days after Melbourne teenager Bianca Adler became the youngest Australian to ever summit the famous mountain.

More than 950 climbers have reached the top of Everest this season, with the weather window rapidly coming to a close.

Five people have died this season — two Indians and three Nepali climbers involved in Everest preparations.

That compares to the 18 people who died in 2023, the deadliest season on the mountain.

title.en: Trump refiles $10bn defamation suit against WSJ over report on Epstein ties – US politics live
title.zh: 特朗普重新提起针对《华尔街日报》的100亿美元诽谤诉讼，涉及爱泼斯坦关系报道 – 美国政治直播

summary.en: Donald Trump has refiled a defamation lawsuit seeking at least $10bn in damages against the Wall Street Journal. The suit concerns a report on his alleged ties to Epstein and is one of several personal lawsuits he has brought against news organizations.

reflection.en: In public disputes, initial reports often shape perceptions, but true understanding requires hearing all sides. This legal action highlights the complex process of examining claims and counter-claims to arrive at a more complete picture.

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: US justice department launches criminal investigation into Trump accuser E Jean Carroll, reports say
title.zh: 据报道，美国司法部对特朗普指控者E·让·卡罗尔展开刑事调查

summary.en: The US Justice Department has reportedly launched a criminal investigation into E. Jean Carroll, focusing on whether the former columnist provided false information regarding the financial support she received for her civil lawsuit against the former US president.
summary.zh: 据报道，美国司法部已对E·让·卡罗尔展开刑事调查，重点是这位前专栏作家是否就其针对美国前总统的民事诉讼所获得的资金提供了虚假信息。

body.en:
The US Department of Justice (DOJ) has opened a criminal investigation into writer E Jean Carroll, who accused President Donald Trump of sexual assault, CBS News, the BBC's US partner, has reported.

The investigation is looking into whether Carroll committed perjury in connection with civil cases she brought against Trump, the news outlet quotes sources as saying.

Carroll, a former magazine columnist, accused Trump of sexual assault and defamation, and successfully sued him in two cases. Both judgements were upheld on appeal, but Trump has since asked the Supreme Court to overturn the first of them.

He has denied the accusations. The BBC has contacted the DOJ and Carroll's lawyer for comment.

In 2023, a jury found Trump liable for sexual assault. He was also found liable for defamation for comments he made the previous year in a post on Truth Social.

In that post, he denied Carroll's claim that she had been attacked by him in the mid-1990s in a New York department store dressing room.

A second lawsuit in 2024 found Trump again liable for defamation in connection with comments he made about Carroll in 2019, in which he accused her of making up the claims against him to sell a book.

Trump has appealed to the US Supreme Court to overturn the first judgement, for which he was ordered to pay $5m (£3.7m) to Carroll. He has also vowed to do the same with the other case, in which Carroll was awarded $83m.

The new criminal case is looking into whether Carroll lied when she said in a 2022 deposition that she received no outside funding for her civil lawsuit against Trump, a source told CBS.

It was revealed in legal papers first filed by Trump's lawyers in 2023 that the co-founder of LinkedIn, Reid Hoffman, had helped to pay for some of Carroll's legal fees and expenses.

The issue was brought up during the case's appeal, and the court found that Carroll had "plausibly represented" in her deposition "that she had forgotten about the limited outside funding counsel obtained".

The "additional discovery... showed that Ms Carroll simply was not involved in the matter of who was or was not funding her litigation costs," the US Court of Appeals for the Second District continued in a 2024 ruling.

The new investigation is being led by the US Attorney's Office for the Northern District of Illinois, one source told CBS.

CNN, which first reported the story, reported that while Carroll's deposition took place in New York, one of the individuals who helped cover some of Carroll's legal fees, Hoffman, has a non-profit organisation based in Chicago.

Acting US Attorney General Todd Blanche, who personally represented Trump in the appeal cases against Carroll, is recused from the case, a source told CBS.

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.

title.en: Iran says it targeted American base after fresh US strikes
title.zh: 伊朗称在美国新一轮袭击后袭击了美国基地

summary.en: Iran has stated it targeted an American base following recent US strikes. These hostilities occur during a delicate ceasefire period and ongoing negotiations aimed at ending a three-month conflict between the US and Iran.
summary.zh: 伊朗表示，在美国近期发动袭击后，它已对一个美国基地进行了打击。这些敌对行动发生在美国和伊朗之间脆弱的停火期间，以及旨在结束长达三个月战争的漫长谈判之中。

body.en:
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) says it has targeted an American air base in the region, after fresh US strikes on southern Iran.

The IRGC did not say where the base was, but Kuwait, which hosts a US base, said it had intercepted "hostile missile and drone threats", without specifying where they were coming from.

Earlier the US military said it had shot down Iranian drones over the Strait of Hormuz and struck a military site in Bandar Abbas, a strategic port city.

It is the second time in three days that the US has attacked targets in Iran - saying that the strikes were conducted in self defence.

The site in Bandar Abbas was struck as it was about to launch a fifth drone, US Central Command (Centcom) said. Iranian media reported that explosions were heard to the east of the city.

Centcom described its actions as "measured, purely defensive, and intended to maintain the ceasefire".

It also said its forces shot down four Iranian one-way attack drones "that posed a threat around the Strait of Hormuz".

The IRGC said it had targeted an American air base "that served as the source of the attack" on Bandar Abbas, according to state broadcaster IRIB.

Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmail Baqai condemned the US strikes and said they constituted a violation of the ceasefire.

He added that the Islamic republic would "take all necessary measures to defend its national sovereignty", according to quotes cited by IRIB.

Earlier this week, the US confirmed a previous round of "self-defence" strikes on southern Iran on Monday in which they targeted Iranian missile sites and boats attempting to lay mines in the Strait, where thousands of commercial tanker ships are stranded as a result of the conflict.

Centcom said those strikes were designed "to protect our troops from threats posed by Iranian forces".

The US also imposed sanctions on the "Persian Gulf Strait Authority" – the Iranian body tasked with collecting payments from ships travelling through the Strait of Hormuz.

Any ships that pay the authority could also be "exposed to the risk of sanctions", the US Treasury Department said in a statement.

One-fifth of the world's liquefied natural gas and oil normally pass through the shipping channel, and its closure has impacted global fuel trade.

Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei said on Monday that Tehran was collecting fees for "navigational services" and it would continue to manage traffic through the waterway.

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent described it as the "Iranian military's latest attempt to extort global maritime trade" and "proof" Iran is "desperate for cash".

body.zh: 伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）表示，在美国对伊朗南部发动新一轮袭击后，他们已经瞄准了该地区的一个美国空军基地。 伊朗革命卫队没有透露该基地在哪里，但拥有美国基地的科威特表示，它拦截了“敌对导弹和无人机威胁”，但没有具体说明它们来自哪里。 此前，美国军方表示，在霍尔木兹海峡上空击落了伊朗无人机，并袭击了战略港口城市阿巴斯港的一处军事基地。 这是三天内第二次袭击伊朗目标，并称袭击是出于自卫。 美国中央司令部（Centcom）表示，阿巴斯港的一个地点在准备发射第五架无人机时遭到袭击。伊朗媒体报道称，该市东部听到爆炸声。 中央司令部将其行动描述为“谨慎的、纯粹的防御性的、旨在维持停火”。 它还表示，其部队击落了四架“对霍尔木兹海峡周围构成威胁”的伊朗单向攻击无人机。 据国家广播公司 IRIB 报道，伊斯兰革命卫队表示，它的目标是阿巴斯港的一个美国空军基地，该基地是“袭击的来源”。 伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴凯谴责美国的袭击，并表示这些袭击违反了停火协议。 据 IRIB 援引的消息称，他补充说，伊斯兰共和国将“采取一切必要措施捍卫其国家主权”。 本周早些时候，美国确认周一对伊朗南部进行了上一轮“自卫”袭击，袭击目标是伊朗导弹基地和试图在该海峡布雷的船只，数千艘商业油轮因冲突而搁浅。 中央司令部表示，这些袭击的目的是“保护我们的军队免受伊朗军队的威胁”。 美国还对“波斯湾海峡管理局”实施制裁，该机构的任务是向通过霍尔木兹海峡的船只收取费用。 美国财政部在一份声明中表示，任何向当局付款的船舶也可能“面临制裁的风险”。 全球五分之一的液化天然气和石油通常通过该航道运输，该航道的关闭影响了全球燃料贸易。 伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴卡伊周一表示，德黑兰正在收取“导航服务”费用，并将继续管理该水道的交通。 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特称这是“伊朗军方勒索全球海上贸易的最新尝试”，并“证明”伊朗“急需现金”。 伊朗革命卫队周二还表示，击落了一架美国无人机，并向一架战斗机和另一架进入伊朗领空的无人机开火，但……

reflection.en: In a world where ceasefires are fragile and negotiations are protracted, the call to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us, remains a profound challenge. This news reminds us of the constant effort required to de-escalate tensions and seek pathways to lasting reconciliation, even when faced with renewed hostilities.
reflection.zh: 在一个停火协议脆弱、谈判旷日持久的世界里，尽力与众人和睦相处的呼召，仍然是一个深刻的挑战。这则新闻提醒我们，即使面对新的敌对行动，也需要持续努力缓和紧张局势，寻求持久和解的途径。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Sixteen pupils killed in Kenya school fire
title.zh: 肯尼亚学校火灾致十六名学生死亡

summary.en: Sixteen pupils were killed and dozens injured in a school fire in Kenya. The cause of the blaze is currently unknown.
summary.zh: 肯尼亚一所学校发生火灾，造成十六名学生死亡，数十人受伤。火灾原因目前尚不清楚。

body.en:
Dozens of other students were injured and taken to hospital - 71 were later discharged and seven admitted for further treatment, Education Minister Julius Ogamba said while visiting the scene of the blaze.

The fire at the Utumishi Girls Academy started in the early hours of Thursday as the students were asleep.

Anxious parents and relatives have been gathering at the scene waiting for news of their loved ones.

Police said search-and-rescue operations were under way with authorities yet to establish the cause of the fire. The Kenya Red Cross said emergency responders were on ground to offer support.

The education minister said the fire broke out on the first floor of one of the dormitories, which was "completely destroyed" in the blaze.

"The response teams managed to put out the fire by about 03:00, but by then the damage had already been done," he said.

He added that the school would begin releasing students to their parents and guardians throughout the day as authorities continue investigations.

Interior Minister Kipchumba Murkomen, who was also among the officials gathered at the school, sent his condolences to the bereaved families.

"It's a very anxious moment and even as we account for the 16 so far identified as having passed on, I want to ask the people of Kenya that together we stand with the families... in prayer, in support.

Earlier speaking to parents and crowds outside the school, police commander Masoud Mwinyi said: "It is a sad and distressing situation."

Fires are not uncommon in Kenyan boarding schools, with several deadly incidents reported in recent years. Many have been the result of arson, with disgruntled pupils - angry about the discipline and living conditions - accused of being responsible, while others were caused by accident.

Overcrowding in dormitories and the failure to follow safety guidelines, such as keeping exits clear and windows unlocked, have frequently been blamed for the high number of casualties.

According to the police, the fire in Gilgil broke out around 01:00 local time (22:00 GMT Wednesday) and engulfed a dormitory block housing about 220 students.

Mwinyi said some students fled into nearby areas during the chaos and were still being traced.

"As we speak, our officers are combing the area because some students fled in shock and fear during the night," he said.

Mwinyi said investigations were ongoing. The school has been cordoned off, with only parents being allowed inside the compound.

Leah Serem, whose daughter is a final-year student at the school, said the news of the fire came as a shock. She said she travelled alongside other parents to the school from the Rift Valley town of Nakuru, about 40km away.

"We were anxious because we didn't know whether our children were alive," she said,...
body.zh: 教育部长朱利叶斯·奥甘巴在视察火灾现场时表示，还有数十名学生受伤并被送往医院，其中 71 人后来出院，7 人入院接受进一步治疗。 周四凌晨，乌图米什女子学院发生火灾，当时学生们正在睡觉。 焦急的父母和亲戚已经聚集在现场，等待亲人的消息。 警方表示，搜救行动正在进行中，当局尚未确定起火原因。肯尼亚红十字会表示，紧急救援人员已在现场提供支持。 教育部长表示，火灾发生在其中一间宿舍的一楼，该宿舍在大火中“完全被毁”。 他说：“响应小组在 03:00 左右成功扑灭了大火，但那时损失已经造成了。” 他补充说，随着当局继续调查，学校将全天将学生交给家长和监护人。 内政部长基普丘巴·穆尔科曼（Kipchumba Murkomen）也是聚集在学校的官员之一，他向遇难者家属表示哀悼。 “这是一个非常焦虑的时刻，尽管我们已经确认了目前已确定的 16 人去世的情况，但我想请求肯尼亚人民与他们的家人站在一起……祈祷并提供支持。 警察指挥官马苏德·姆维尼早些时候对家长和学校外的人群发表讲话说：“这是一个悲伤和令人痛苦的情况。” 肯尼亚寄宿学校发生火灾并不罕见，近年来曾发生多起致命事件。其中许多是纵火造成的，心怀不满的学生——对纪律和生活条件感到愤怒——被指控为纵火，而另一些则是意外造成的。 宿舍过度拥挤以及不遵守安全准则（例如保持出口畅通和窗户未锁）经常被指责为造成大量伤亡的原因。 据警方称，吉尔吉尔的火灾于当地时间01:00（格林威治标准时间周三22:00）左右爆发，吞没了容纳约220名学生的宿舍楼。 姆维尼说，一些学生在混乱期间逃到附近地区，目前仍在追踪中。 他说：“就在我们说话的时候，我们的官员正在对该地区进行搜查，因为一些学生在夜间因震惊和恐惧而逃离。” 姆维尼表示，调查正在进行中。学校已被封锁，只允许家长进入校园。 莉亚·塞雷姆 (Leah Serem) 的女儿是该校最后一年级的学生，她表示火灾的消息令人震惊。她说，她和其他家长一起从约 40 公里外的东非大裂谷小镇纳库鲁来到学校。 她说：“我们很焦虑，因为我们不知道我们的孩子是否还活着。”

reflection.en: The tragic loss of young lives in this school fire brings immense sorrow and reminds us of the fragility of life. In moments of profound grief, we hold onto the promise that one day, all tears will be wiped away, and death and suffering will be no more. This hope offers solace to those mourning and enduring unimaginable pain.
reflection.zh: 这起学校火灾中年轻生命的悲惨逝去带来了巨大的悲痛，提醒我们生命的脆弱。在极度悲伤的时刻，我们紧紧抓住那应许，有一天，所有的眼泪都将被擦干，死亡和痛苦将不复存在。这份盼望为那些哀悼和承受着难以想象痛苦的人们带来慰藉。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: US: Former CIA officer charged with stealing gold bars from government
title.zh: 美国：前中情局官员被控窃取政府金条

summary.en: A former CIA official, who held top-secret clearance, has been accused of stealing millions of dollars worth of gold bars from the US government and storing them at his residence. Investigators also reportedly confiscated foreign currency and luxury watches from his home.
summary.zh: 一名前美国中央情报局（CIA）官员被指控窃取政府价值数百万美元的金条并藏匿于家中。该官员曾拥有最高机密级别的权限。调查人员还查获了外币和奢侈手表。

body.zh: 一名拥有绝密级别许可的前中央情报局官员被指控从美国政府窃取价值数百万美元的金条并将其藏在家中。调查人员还查获了外币和豪华手表。 美国中央情报局 (CIA) 兰利总部所在地弗吉尼亚州的联邦法院文件显示，一名前官员被指控从政府盗窃了数百条金条和其他贵重物品。 据美联社报道，根据法庭文件，该男子上周被捕并被指控犯有盗窃公共资金的刑事罪。 调查此案的联邦调查局特工在一份证词中称，从 2025 年 11 月到今年 3 月，该男子索取并收到了“大量外币和数千万美元的金条，用于与工作相关的费用”。 据称，目前尚不清楚他打算如何使用这些资金，但其中一部分是在他办公室附近的储藏室中发现的。 5 月 18 日，联邦官员搜查了他的家，查获了 300 多根金条，估计价值超过 4000 万美元（约合 3500 万欧元）。 证词称，他们还扣押了价值约 200 万美元的外币和约 35 块豪华手表，其中许多是劳力士手表。 虽然调查人员没有透露被告计划如何处理这些材料，但证词得出的结论是，有可能有理由相信他“故意贪污、偷窃、盗窃或故意转换美国有价值的物品”供个人使用。 宣誓书没有详细说明嫌疑人在中央情报局的角色，但将他描述为“美国政府机构的前高级行政服务级雇员”——指的是该组织中最高级别的文职领导人，该机构通常必须获得绝密级别的许可。 美联社报道称，联邦调查局发言人拒绝进一步置评，中央情报局也没有回复电子邮件询问。 联邦调查局的证词还称，嫌疑人似乎多年来一直在其教育和军事背景方面撒谎。 调查发现，他谎称自己是一名前海军飞行员，毕业于南卡罗来纳州克莱姆森大学和纽约伦斯勒理工学院。相反，他们发现他没有上过这两所大学，而是在 1997 年至 2015 年间先后在海军和海军预备役服役，晋升中尉军衔，而且似乎从未接受过飞行员评估。 编者注：德国之声遵循德国的新闻守则，该守则强调在许多案件中保护被告隐私的重要性，尤其是在定罪之前。

reflection.en: The news of a trusted official allegedly stealing millions in gold and luxury items highlights the powerful allure of wealth. This incident serves as a sober reminder that the love of money can indeed be a root of many evils, leading individuals to betray trust and compromise integrity for material gain.
reflection.zh: 一位受信任的官员被指控窃取数百万美元的金条和奢侈品，这凸显了财富的巨大诱惑。这起事件严肃地提醒我们，贪财确实是万恶之根，它能使人背弃信任，为了物质利益而损害诚信。

verse.textEn: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
verse.textZh: 贪财是万恶之根。

title.en: Heavy Israeli strikes hit southern Lebanon after large-scale evacuation orders
title.zh: 以色列大规模撤离令后，黎巴嫩南部遭猛烈袭击

summary.en: The Israeli military has issued orders for residents to evacuate approximately 17% of Lebanon's territory following heavy strikes in the southern region.
summary.zh: 以色列军方在对黎巴嫩南部地区进行猛烈打击后，已命令居民撤离该国约17%的领土。

body.en:
Waves of Israeli strikes have hit southern Lebanon, targeting Hezbollah infrastructure, according to the Israeli military.

Social media videos from Tyre, one of Lebanon's biggest cities, show dust-covered crowds of people gathered around collapsed buildings.

On Wednesday, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) had urged residents to move north of the Zahrani River, about 40km (25 miles) from the Israeli border, saying it would act "with extreme force".

Both Israel and Hezbollah - the powerful Shia group supported by Iran, have accused each other of repeated violations of a ceasefire which came into force on 17 April.

Two sets of Israeli strikes hit Tyre and an area to the city's east on Thursday morning, Lebanon's state-run National News Agency (NNA) reported.

Footage from Tyre captured explosions and fires burning through the night and into Thursday morning.

Videos showed streets lit orange by flames, smoke-filled roads, and at least one vehicle engulfed in fire.

By daylight, a massive fireball was filmed erupting near a cluster of high-rise residential buildings, sending a mushroom-shaped column of smoke rising above the city skyline.

A Hezbollah member in Tyre told the BBC rescue and recovery crews have had to stop their work because conditions remain "too dangerous" and workers received calls from the Israeli military warning them to evacuate the area.

Ambulance teams in Tyre are continuing to drive through neighbourhoods urging residents to leave, amid fears of further strikes.

More Israeli evacuation orders were issued overnight as people were asleep. The scale of displacement is now straining the wider region.

Shelters in the city of Sidon have reached full capacity, the head of the municipality told the BBC, with no space remaining for newly displaced people. Tyre's authorities are advising residents to travel further north to the capital, Beirut.

Additionally, NNA reported that an Israeli drone strike had hit a family trying to flee threatened villages in southern Lebanon for safety, killing six people, including children.

Wednesday's evacuation order was the largest since the ceasefire took effect, covering about 14% of Lebanese territory.

The strikes came after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced an expansion of its ground operation following Hezbollah drone attacks on troops occupying part of southern Lebanon and on civilians in northern Israel.

title.en: Fire in Kenya girls' school dormitory kills 16, injures 73
title.zh: 肯尼亚女子学校宿舍火灾致16人死亡，73人受伤

summary.en: A fire in a girls' school dormitory in Kenya resulted in the deaths of 16 students and injuries to 73 others. Local authorities reported that 220 girls were sleeping in the dormitory when the blaze occurred.
summary.zh: 肯尼亚一所女子学校宿舍发生火灾，造成16名学生死亡，73人受伤。当地政府表示，火灾发生时，有220名女生正在宿舍内睡觉。

body.en:
A fire in a girls' school dormitory in Kenya on Thursday has left 16 dead and 73 hospitalised, a police source told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency.

The fire broke out at around 1.00 am local time in Utumishi Girls Academy in Nakuru County, around 120 kilometres north of the capital Nairobi, local media said.

It was not immediately clear if all the casualties were children, but a statement from local authorities said the fire broke out in a dorm where around 220 girls were sleeping.

"First responders, ambulance crew and our support personnel are currently on the ground," a spokesperson for the Kenyan Red Cross told AFP, declining to give a toll.

The school is linked to the National Police Service, in an area that hosts several army and training facilities.

Frantic parents were being held outside the school buildings by authorities, according to local media.

There have been many devastating school fires in Kenya, where boarding schools are common as a colonial legacy of missionaries and the British.

A fire in 2024 killed 21 boys after flames engulfed a dormitory at the Hillside Endarasha Academy in Nyeri county.

Children have been accused of deliberately starting fires in the past. One report found there were 63 arson cases at schools in 2018 alone.

A 2017 report by Kenya's National Crime Research Centre blamed exam stress and long school terms, and said students in different schools were communicating via smuggled phones, leading to copycat acts.

After the deadly 2024 fire, the government promised a safety audit of all schools and to prosecute violators.

title.en: Crises in Amhara, Tigray cloud Ethiopia's election 2026
title.zh: 阿姆哈拉和提格雷危机给埃塞俄比亚2026年大选蒙上阴影

summary.en: Ethiopia is preparing for June 1 elections amidst ongoing crises in Amhara and Tigray. The polls are set to address critical national debates on federalism, governance, and unity, which will be pivotal in shaping the country's democratic trajectory.
summary.zh: 埃塞俄比亚将于6月1日举行选举，但阿姆哈拉州和提格雷州的危机给选举蒙上阴影。此次投票将围绕联邦制、治理和国家统一等关键议题展开辩论，这些议题将决定该国民主的未来。

body.en:
The June 1 elections come as the country debates federalism, governance and national unity in polls that could define the country's democratic future.

Days before the vote,  Ethiopia's  electoral body, the National Election Board of Ethiopia (NEBE), announced that elections would not take place in 46 electoral districts in the conflict-affected Amhara and Tigray regions, citing insecurity and political tensions.

The NEBE said voting would not take place in eight of the 138 electoral districts in the northwestern Amhara region because of what it described as "unfavorable conditions" amid clashes between militia groups and the army . The board also suspended voting in 38 districts in Tigray, where tensions remain high between the federal government and the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF ).

Ethiopia's 130 million citizens are hoping for an improvement in their daily lives when they go to the polls for parliamentary elections on June 1 .

"Even though I'm not satisfied with the current economic situation, I believe the ruling Prosperity party will remain in power," a 50-year-old man in Addis Ababa, who chose to remain anonymous, told DW.

Another young voter spoke of the necessity for peace in the country, saying that only then can real development be realized. "That would alleviate the current inflation problem ," he told DW, adding that he hopes the election would result in peace and stability.

"Elections are always good," said a 26-year-old man in Ethiopia's capital, who also opted to remain anonymous. "But too little attention is being paid to the problems of people struggling with inflation." As a young citizen, he said he was very concerned about the exodus of many young Ethiopians to other countries due to a lack of jobs.

Contrary to the hopes of the suffering people, experts say  the situation will remain fragile . "The elections in Ethiopia will be a purely formal affair that lends the government electoral legitimacy. There is no way to change or challenge the government through the elections," Kjetil Tronvoll, a peace and conflict researcher at Oslo New University College, told DW. For him, the electoral process is a symbolic exercise rather than a political contest.

The Coalition for the Unity of Ethiopia (CEU) , an alliance of several opposition parties is voicing similar criticisms. The CEU is calling for "an end to the war, the release of political prisoners, greater political freedom, and talks with the genuine opposition and the elites as a prerequisite for the elections," spokesperson Getnet Worku said.

Iranian media reported three loud explosions rang out in the port city of Bandar Abbas on Thursday, following US strikes earlier in the week that underscored the fragile state of a diplomatic push to get a provisional peace agreement across the finish line.

"Today, US Central Command Forces shot down four Iranian one-way attack drones that posed a threat around the Strait of Hormuz," a US official, speaking on condition of anonymity, said in a statement to news agency Agence France-Presse.

"US forces also struck an Iranian ground control station in Bandar Abbas that was about to launch a fifth drone," the official said.

Shortly after the latest US strikes, the Iranian Revolutionary Guards targeted a US base in retaliation, Iran's state broadcaster IRIB reported.

The US leader warned he might be compelled to "finish the job" if a better arrangement was not reached, even as optimism for a peace deal that would reopen the Hormuz trade route sent oil prices tumbling.

Iran has indicated that it seeks to impose a new reality in the Strait of Hormuz, through which one-fifth of the world's oil normally passes, exacting tolls on transiting ships and sharing the revenues with Oman.

reflection.zh: 即使在停火协议中，持续的交火和升级循环也令人感到力不从心，这表明冲突的根源可能比表面争端更深。这提醒我们，我们真正的争战往往不仅仅是与人对抗，更是与那些助长分裂和敌意的无形势力对抗。在这样的时刻，属灵的视角可以帮助我们理解和平所面临的严峻挑战，并引导我们为智慧和解决方案祷告。

verse.textEn: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verse.textZh: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。

title.en: FIFA World Cup: New York and New Jersey prosecutors probe 'sky-high' ticket prices
title.zh: FIFA世界杯：纽约和新泽西州检察官调查“天价”门票

summary.en: US prosecutors have subpoenaed FIFA over expensive World Cup tickets, stating that the event should not be an opportunity to exploit residents and visitors.
summary.zh: 美国检察官已就世界杯高价门票问题向国际足联发出传票，称该赛事不应成为“剥削当地居民和游客的借口”。

body.zh: 美国检察官就昂贵的世界杯门票向国际足联发出传票，称该赛事“不是邀请我们剥削我们的居民和游客”。 国际足联面临纽约州和新泽西州的传票，这是对 2026 年世界杯门票定价细节以及向球迷承诺的座位位置准确性进行调查的一部分。 该赛事是历史上费用最高的世界杯，将于 6 月中旬开始，并将在美国、加拿大和墨西哥举行比赛。该活动已经引发了对一系列政治和经济问题的广泛批评，其中包括周三检察官谴责的“席位天价”。 纽约总检察长利蒂西亚·詹姆斯和新泽西州总检察长詹妮弗·达文波特在一份联合声明中表示，2026 年世界杯比赛的价格“远远超过了以往任何世界杯比赛的价格”。 詹姆斯说：“纽约人多年来一直在等待世界杯来到他们的后院，他们应该有公平的机会买到实惠的门票。” “任何人都不应该被操纵支付天价购买座位，球迷应该能够相信他们购买的门票就是他们收到的门票。” 世界杯决赛定于 7 月 19 日在纽约巨人队和喷气机队的主场新泽西州大都会人寿体育场举行。 “诚实地对待门票销售并不复杂。但国际足联已经将购买世界杯门票变成了一场混乱、虚假稀缺和难以置信的高价的挑战，”詹妮弗·达文波特说。 国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺（Gianni Infantino）辩称，由于美国体育赛事的高标准价格和全球的巨大需求，其“动态定价”是必要的。他还部分归咎于美国法律，该法律规定不可能禁止购票后转售门票。 然而，除了最便宜的门票（数量相对较少且仅在低风险小组赛阶段提供）之外，所有门票都明显比美国典型的体育赛事入场费贵。 进入 7 月份的决赛预计将花费普通球迷数千美元，这比参加 2022 年在石油资源丰富的卡塔尔举行的激动人心的决赛的费用高出五倍。 达文波特说：“主办世界杯是一种荣幸，但这项活动并不是要剥削我们的居民和游客。” 检察官的调查绝不是围绕这些费用的第一次审查或丑闻。 支持者团体已向欧盟提出有关定价的正式投诉。 停车费和前往体育场的火车票等补充费用也成为了头条新闻。 国际足联已经做出了一些姿态，比如非常有限地发布低价......

reflection.en: The pursuit of excessive profit, especially during events meant to bring people together, can lead to exploitation. This story reminds us of the importance of fair dealing and integrity in all commercial transactions.
reflection.zh: 过度追求利润，尤其是在旨在团结人们的活动中，可能导致剥削。这个故事提醒我们，在所有商业交易中，公平交易和诚信的重要性。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: Trump urges Middle East states to sign Abraham Accords
title.zh: 特朗普敦促中东国家签署《亚伯拉罕协议》

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has urged more Middle Eastern countries to join the Abraham Accords that aim to normalize relations with Israel. The agreement seeks to foster cooperation and reduce tensions in the region.
summary.zh: 美国前总统唐纳德·特朗普敦促更多中东国家加入旨在使与以色列关系正常化的《亚伯拉罕协议》。该协议旨在促进该地区的合作并减少紧张局势。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump has urged more Middle Eastern countries to join the Abraham Accords that aim to normalize relations with Israel. What does the agreement entail?

The Abraham Accords — named after the biblical figure Abraham who is considered the founding father of Judaism, Christianity and Islam — were mediated by the US during President Donald Trump's first term (2017-2021) in office. They aim to normalize relations between Israel and various Arab and Muslim nations.

The Abraham Accords stipulate that signatory parties aim to foster peace and seek to engage in dialogue and cooperation in science, art, medicine and trade. The agreement, however, is short and remains rather vague, lacking any detailed measures.

Trump has now called on further countries to sign the Abraham Accords Declaration . His appeal comes as talks continue to on how to end the Iran war .

In a post on his Truth Social platform, Trump named Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Pakistan, Turkey, Egypt and Jordan as potential new signatories, though he admitted some countries may be hesitant to join. That said, Trump expects "most [states] should be ready, willing."

He continued to say Saudi Arabia and Qatar should sign immediately and claimed states refusing to join show "bad intention." 

Trump painted a rosy picture of the region, brushing over existing rivalries and downright animosities.

According to Trump, signing the Abraham Accords would create a "Middle East [that] would be United, Powerful, and Economically Strong, like perhaps no other area, anywhere in the World!" He added that if Iran were to sign up, "it would be an Honor to have them also be part of this unparalleled World Coalition."

In 2020, the Trump government mediated the Abraham Accords to normalize ties between Israel and the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Morocco as well as Sudan, facilitating a historic rapprochement.

Last year, the former Soviet republic of Kazakhstan also joined the framework, although it has already maintained diplomatic relations with Israel since 1992.

The Abraham Accords are considered the first step towards regional normalization since the peace treaties signed between Isreal and Egypt in 1979 and the agreement struck with Jordan in 1994. Supporters of the Abraham Accords point to growing regional initiatives and trade with partner countries. Indeed, Israel and the United Arab Emirates have reached a number of deals, including a five-year agreement to share agricultural know-how.

The Abraham framework has been viewed as a diplomatic breakthrough, dispelling the prior assumption that regional normalization is only possible after the Israeli-Palestinian conflict is resolved and a two-state solution implemented.

Some observers, however, criticize this very...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普敦促更多中东国家加入旨在实现与以色列关系正常化的《亚伯拉罕协议》。该协议意味着什么？ 《亚伯拉罕协议》——以圣经人物亚伯拉罕的名字命名，亚伯拉罕被认为是犹太教、基督教和伊斯兰教的创始人——是在唐纳德·特朗普总统第一任期（2017-2021）期间由美国斡旋达成的。他们的目标是实现以色列与各个阿拉伯和穆斯林国家之间的关系正常化。 《亚伯拉罕协议》规定，签署方以促进和平为目标，寻求在科学、艺术、医学和贸易等领域开展对话与合作。然而，该协议很短，而且仍然相当模糊，缺乏任何具体措施。 特朗普现在呼吁更多国家签署《亚伯拉罕协议宣言》。他发出呼吁之际，有关如何结束伊朗战争的谈判仍在继续。 特朗普在其真相社交平台上发表的一篇文章中，将沙特阿拉伯、卡塔尔、巴基斯坦、土耳其、埃及和约旦列为潜在的新签署国，但他承认一些国家可能对加入犹豫不决。也就是说，特朗普预计“大多数[州]应该做好准备，愿意”。 他继续表示沙特阿拉伯和卡塔尔应立即签署，并声称拒绝加入的国家表现出“不良意图”。 特朗普为该地区描绘了一幅美好的图景，忽视了现有的竞争和彻头彻尾的敌意。 特朗普表示，签署《亚伯拉罕协议》将创建一个“团结、强大、经济强大的中东，这可能是世界上任何其他地区都无法比拟的！”他补充说，如果伊朗加入，“他们也将很荣幸成为这个无与伦比的世界联盟的一部分。” 2020 年，特朗普政府斡旋达成《亚伯拉罕协议》，实现了以色列与阿拉伯联合酋长国、巴林、摩洛哥和苏丹之间的关系正常化，促进了历史性的和解。 去年，前苏联共和国哈萨克斯坦也加入了该框架，尽管该国自1992年以来就已与以色列保持外交关系。 《亚伯拉罕协议》被认为是自 1979 年以色列和埃及签署和平条约以及 1994 年与约旦达成协议以来迈向区域正常化的第一步。《亚伯拉罕协议》的支持者指出区域倡议和与伙伴国家的贸易不断增长。事实上，以色列和阿拉伯联合酋长国已经达成了多项协议，包括一项为期五年的农业技术共享协议。 亚伯拉罕框架被视为外交突破，打破了之前的假设，即只有在巴以冲突得到解决并实施两国解决方案后，地区正常化才有可能实现。 然而，一些观察家对此提出批评...

reflection.en: Efforts to normalize relations between nations, like the Abraham Accords, reflect a pursuit of peace in a complex world. Such diplomatic initiatives, though challenging, embody the spirit of peacemaking that seeks to build bridges rather than walls.
reflection.zh: 像《亚伯拉罕协议》这样旨在使国家间关系正常化的努力，反映了在一个复杂世界中对和平的追求。这些外交举措，尽管充满挑战，却体现了旨在建立桥梁而非隔阂的缔造和平精神。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Five people trapped in Laos cave found alive, but rescuers say extraction will be complex
title.zh: 老挝洞穴中被困的五人被发现生还，但救援人员称营救工作将很复杂

summary.en: Rescue teams have located five individuals alive who were trapped in a cave in Laos. Efforts are ongoing to extract them, and rescuers continue to search for two other missing members of the group.
summary.zh: 救援队在老挝的一个洞穴中发现了五名被困人员生还。营救工作仍在进行中，救援人员也继续搜寻该团队中另外两名失踪成员。

body.en:
Specialist divers have found five of seven people trapped for a week in a flooded cave in Laos alive, with one rescuer saying their extraction from its terminal chamber was the next challenge.

The seven Laotians entered the cave in central Xaysomboun province, northeast of the capital Vientiane, on 20 May, according to state media.

They were searching for gold but got trapped inside the cave after heavy rain triggered flash flooding, blocking their exit, it said.

Five men with their clothes, hands and faces covered in mud huddled in a tight passage of the cave, while two rescuers in dive gear and standing in stomach-deep water filmed them, a video posted by Thai rescuer Chakkit Taengtan showed.

"We found five Laotians. Everybody is safe. We'll continue to provide help," Thai rescue diver Norrased Palasing said in the video.

Finnish diver Mikko Paasi, also seen in the cave footage, said he and Norrased needed to "dive straight back" and bring the men more supplies to gain strength and prepare to exit the cave.

"This is only a brief relief as the five survivors are still in the terminal chamber, all healthy and in good spirits, but the extraction is still ahead and it ain't going to be easy," said Paasi in a social media post.

State-run Lao Security News said rescuers would now bring food and medicine to the five survivors and continue searching for the two others who are missing.

Other Laotian and Thai rescue groups also posted saying five people were found alive.

Paasi said earlier on Wednesday that rescuers were "racing against time" to extract the seven from the cave, which he called an "abandoned gold mine".

Rescuers needed to "navigate hundreds of meters of constant restrictions, flood waters, collapse hazards and high risk of contaminated air quality" inside the cave, he said in a Facebook post.

The terminal chamber, where the five were found, was around 300m from the exit, he said.

The seven had entered the cave "with resources to stay sub-terrain for several days", the diver added.

Norrased and Paasi, who arrived at the Laos cave on Monday, were among the rescuers who aided the dramatic 2018 retrieval of a youth football team from a flooded cave in neighbouring Thailand.

The "Wild Boars" team spent nearly three weeks trapped by flash floods in the Tham Luang cave complex in Thailand's north.

The Laos cave system, located in a remote area, extends deep underground, with multiple levels and narrow passages.

Authorities and villagers have worked to pump water out, but rescue teams were unable to reach the group earlier this week, according to state media.

title.en: 'Shameful': Outrage as New Zealand scraps its standalone environment department
title.zh: “可耻！”新西兰废除独立环保部门引发众怒

summary.en: New Zealand is facing public criticism after announcing legal changes that will abolish its dedicated environment department. Environmental management responsibilities will now be absorbed into a larger "mega-ministry" that also oversees housing, urban development, and transport.
summary.zh: 新西兰宣布将废除其独立的环保部门，并将其职能并入一个涵盖住房、城市发展和交通的“超级部委”，此举引发了公众的强烈不满。

body.en:
New Zealand's Ministry for the Environment is set to be scrapped entirely under new legislation passed on Wednesday.

The bill to dismantle the agency was introduced by the centre-right National Party in February and incorporated a public submission as part of the procedure.

The ministry for the environment will now be folded into a new "mega-ministry" for cities, environment, regions, and transport, known as MCERT.

The changes have been condemned by the NZ Greens Party and the Labour Party, which both voted against the bill.

"The track record of this government is just bad for our environment," Labour MP Rachel Brooking, former minister for oceans, said. "We know their track record is to cut, cut, cut, and to make things into culture wars , and it is deplorable."

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"This government is cementing their place as the most anti-environment government in New Zealand's history. This is a shameful end of an era," said Green Party environment spokesperson Lan Pham.

NZ environment minister Nicola Grigg, speaking in the country's parliament, argued that the legal change is purely functional.

"The Environment Act of 1986, with the requirement to advise the minister for the environment on all of the aspects of environmental administration continues as it is today — it does not go away," she said.

"The act's requirement to resolve conflicts with environmental policies does not go away. The role of the secretary of the environment does not go away.

Public submissions from New Zealanders on the proposed changes were almost entirely against the idea. The bill was given legal consideration by the Environmental Select Committee for just 40 minutes.

"At a time when all our environmental outcomes across freshwater, air, biodiversity and oceans are going backwards, climate change is flooding communities week after week, costing billions of dollars, lives, and livelihoods, this Government's response is to dismantle the ministry responsible for environmental protection," Pham said.

"This is yet another callous blow to the environment, where this Government is demonstrating their only intention for the environment is to exploit it for a quick buck. New Zealanders deserve so much better."

The National government has argued the issues the new ministry will manage are fundamentally intertwined but have been difficult to address in a siloed system. They say joining the departments will improve efficiency.

Grigg argues that other countries like France, Türkiye, Switzerland, and Finland all have similarly combined departments to administer their environmental laws.

body.en:
A Chinese dissident who fled his country on a rubber boat has been detained in South Korea after spending hours at sea.

Dong Guangping, a former police officer and human rights activist, was found in Korean waters on Monday night.

South Korea's coast guard told the BBC that Dong is under investigation for suspected immigration violations and his case will be referred to prosecutors.

The 68-year-old had been jailed in China several times for his activism, such as taking part in events to commemorate the Tiananmen Square crackdown . Dong had escaped China at least three times previously, but was sent back each time.

When asked about Monday's incident China's foreign affairs ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said she had not aware of the case.

Dong had set out from Weifang, a city in the central Shandong province, in a rubber boat with an engine, according to Canada-based activist Sheng Xue who posted on X saying she had spoken to Dong after he reached South Korea.

He had told her that he had spent more than 30 hours at sea, and was "fainting" from exhaustion by the time he reached the waters off Taean, a county on South Korea's western coast.

South Korea's coast guard said they rescued him after receiving a report from a fishing boat that had spotted Dong.

Dong had previously discussed his escape plan with Sheng Xue, she said, but she had told him it would be too dangerous.

"He ended up really doing it... Dong Guangping is too tenacious, too brave," she said, adding that he had planned his escape with "meticulous checks and preparation".

Human Rights in China (HRIC), an NGO based in New York, has urged Seoul to "uphold humanitarian principles and international human rights obligations" by not handing Dong over to China, where he "faces a grave risk of persecution and torture".

It also called on Korean authorities to allow Dong to seek political asylum, or help facilitate his safe passage to Canada where his family members live.

"That a man nearing seventy years old was driven to cross open seas in a small inflatable boat is itself a devastating indictment of China's human rights situation," HRIC said.

In 1999, Dong was fired from the police force after he signed a petition to commemorate the 10th anniversary of the brutal Tiananmen crackdown on pro-democracy protesters.

Then in 2001, he was imprisoned for three years for "inciting subversion of state power". He was jailed again in 2014 for participating in another Tiananmen commemoration event, according to Amnesty International.

He first escaped China in October 2015 when he travelled to Bangkok with his wife and daughter, where they were granted refugee status by the United Nations and approved for resettlement in Canada.

title.en: Chinese dissident found at sea detained in South Korea

body.en:
Dong Guangping, a former policeman who has been jailed for his opposition to China's Communist regime, was found drifting in a small rubber boat off South Korea's west coast.

A Chinese dissident was detained by South Korean authorities this week after he was found drifting in a small rubber boat off the country's west coast, his lawyer said Wednesday.

South Korean authorities found Dong Guangping, a former policeman who was imprisoned in China for his activism, drifting in a small rubber boat off the coast of Taean County, in South Chungcheong Province, on Monday night, police said.

He has been detained and is being questioned for allegedly violating South Korean immigration laws, the Taean coast guard said in a statement.

Kim didn't say from where Dong had launched his 3.3-meter-long (11 feet) boat, which was equipped with a 10-horsepower engine.

Dong is known for his criticism of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) and his political reform and human rights advocacy.

US-based group Human Rights in China says Dong was fired from his job as a policeman after he signed a petition a decade after the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown .

He was imprisoned for three years in around 2001 for "inciting subversion of state power" and was detained again in 2014 over activities related to the Tiananmen Square protests and massacre.

Dong has previously tried to escape from China. He fled to Thailand with his family, who were later resettled in Canada. Despite Dong being recognized by the UN as having refugee status, Thai authorities handed him over to Chinese police in 2015.

His attorney told AFP that Dong's current situation is "highly likely to be a political asylum case."

The New York Times , which first reported on Dong's detention on Tuesday, said the dissident had also previously escaped to Vietnam and Taiwan, only to be returned to China each time.

Chinese-Canadian activist Sheng Xue has previously shared news of Dong's attempted escapes on social media, including when he was arrested and deported in 2021 by Vietnamese authorities.

The right-wing opposition People Power Party has urged the government, led by the liberal Democratic Party, to offer Dong its "full protection."

"It should take swift humanitarian measures to ensure that he can safely travel to Canada, where his family is anxiously awaiting him," party spokesman Choo Hyun-chul said in a statement carried by AFP.

"This is a matter of a fundamental responsibility as a liberal democratic state," Choo added.

South Korean President Lee Jae-myung and other left-wing administrations have preferred conciliatory foreign policy approaches towards China . It is unclear whether this approach will impact Dong's case.

title.en: Chinese human rights cases in limbo after Trump-Xi summit
title.zh: 特朗普-习近平峰会后，中国人权案件悬而未决

summary.en: Following a summit between President Trump and President Xi, discussions reportedly included the issue of political prisoners in China, such as Hong Kong media tycoon Jimmy Lai. Human rights advocates are now urging the United States to increase pressure on China ahead of President Xi's upcoming visit to Washington.
summary.zh: 据报道，在特朗普总统和习近平主席举行峰会后，双方讨论了中国政治犯问题，其中包括香港媒体大亨黎智英。人权倡导者们正敦促美国在习近平主席即将访问华盛顿之前，对中国施加更大压力。

body.en:
Trump and Xi said they had discussed political prisoners in China, including Hong Kong media tycoon Jimmy Lai. Ahead of Xi's September visit to Washington, advocates are urging the US to apply more pressure on China.

During his summit with China's Xi Jinping this month , US President Donald Trump said that he brought up two prisoners — Christian pastor Ezra Jin Mingri and Hong Kong media mogul Jimmy Lai.

Mingri is the founder of the Zion Protestant Church, one of China 's largest underground churches,  who was arrested in 2025 .

Lai, meanwhile, was sentenced in February to 20 years for foreign collusion and sedition over his ownership of the now-defunct, pro-democracy Apple Daily  newspaper.

In remarks to reporters on May 15, Trump said Xi had said he would "strongly consider the pastor." But the US president pointed out that his Chinese counterpart had described Lai's case as "a tough one," with Trump admitting he "didn't feel optimistic" about it.

Afterward, both Jin's and Lai's families thanked Trump and the White House for the support at such a closely watched summit. 

"We're really grateful that the President mentioned my father at such a consequential meeting," Grace Jin Drexel, Pastor Jin's daughter, told DW.

Lai's daughter, Claire Lai, also thanked the Trump administration "for their commitment to my father's release" as she received Lai's Freedom Award from Freedom House last week.

However, since Trump's remarks, there have been no further updates from either Washington or Beijing.

"We have not heard any other developments other than what's been made public," Drexel said. "I trust that the administration and all the staff in his [Trump] cabinet are following up."

With Trump inviting Xi to the White House in September, advocacy groups see that upcoming visit as a chance to pressure the Chinese leader to release political prisoners. 

"We in the activist community are very focused on Xi Jinping's visit," Mark Clifford, the president of the Committee for Freedom in Hong Kong and former director of Lai's publisher Next Digital, told DW. "Although Trump tried to downplay expectations, he never said it was impossible."

Jin and 17 Zion Church members have been detained in Guangxi, China, since the government arrested 29 people in October 2025. The pastor was charged with "illegally using information networks" for online preaching in the unregistered underground Protestant church, which operates outside government control.

Drexel said that her father "is not doing well in prison" and that Jin has diabetes. As Trump stated that Xi was considering releasing the pastor, Drexel remained "cautiously optimistic."

"This is all very new, and I don't think anyone really has prepared or has a playbook," she said....
body.zh: 特朗普和习近平表示，他们讨论了中国的政治犯问题，其中包括香港媒体大亨黎智英。在习近平九月访问华盛顿之前，支持者敦促美国对中国施加更多压力。 在本月与中国习近平的峰会上，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他抚养了两名囚犯——基督教牧师以斯拉·金明日和香港媒体大亨黎智英。 明日是中国最大的地下教会之一锡安基督教会的创始人，于 2025 年被捕。 与此同时，黎智英于 2 月份因与外国勾结和煽动叛乱而被判处 20 年徒刑，罪名是其拥有现已不复存在的亲民主报纸《苹果日报》。 特朗普在 5 月 15 日对记者发表讲话时表示，习近平曾表示他将“强烈考虑这位牧师”。但这位美国总统指出，中国同行将黎智英的案件描述为“一个艰难的案件”，特朗普承认他对此“并不乐观”。 随后，金和赖的家人都感谢特朗普和白宫在如此备受关注的峰会上提供的支持。 金牧师的女儿格蕾丝·金·德雷克塞尔 (Grace Jin Drexel) 告诉德国之声：“我们真的很感激总统在如此重要的会议上提到了我的父亲。” 黎智英的女儿克莱尔·黎(Claire Lai)上周获得自由之家颁发的黎智英自由奖，并感谢特朗普政府“对释放我父亲的承诺”。 然而，自特朗普发表上述言论以来，华盛顿和北京都没有进一步的更新。 “除了已公开的消息外，我们还没有听到任何其他进展，”德雷克塞尔说。 “我相信政府和他的[特朗普]内阁的所有工作人员都会跟进。” 随着特朗普于 9 月份邀请习近平访问白宫，倡导团体将这次即将到来的访问视为向中国领导人施压释放政治犯的一个机会。 香港自由委员会主席、黎智英出版社壹传媒前董事马克·克利福德 (Mark Clifford) 告诉德国之声：“我们活动界非常关注习近平的访问。” “尽管特朗普试图淡化期望，但他从未说过这是不可能的。” 自 2025 年 10 月政府逮捕了 29 人以来，金和 17 名锡安教会成员在中国广西被拘留。该牧师被指控“非法使用信息网络”在未经注册的地下新教教会进行在线讲道，该教会在政府控制之外运作。 德雷克塞尔说，她的父亲“在监狱里过得不好”，而且金患有糖尿病。当特朗普表示习近平正在考虑释放这位牧师时，德雷克塞尔仍然保持“谨慎乐观”。 “这一切都是非常新的，我认为没有人真正准备好或有剧本，”她说……

reflection.en: The news highlights the ongoing plight of political prisoners and the crucial role of advocates who speak on their behalf. Proverbs 31:8 calls us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, reminding us of the moral imperative to defend the rights of the vulnerable. This principle encourages us to support efforts that seek justice and freedom...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了政治犯的持续困境，以及倡导者为他们发声的关键作用。箴言31:8呼吁我们为那些不能为自己说话的人发声，提醒我们有道德责任去捍卫弱势群体的权利。这一原则鼓励我们支持那些为被不公正囚禁者寻求正义和自由的努力。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: New Chinese surveillance leaves foreigners nowhere to hide
title.zh: 中国新监控系统让外国人无处藏身

summary.en: A Chinese cybersecurity expert has disclosed details of China's advanced high-tech policing system to DW. This system uses facial recognition at ski resorts and tracks individuals on trains, compiling comprehensive "holistic profiles" that leave foreigners with no place to hide.
summary.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声透露了中国新型高科技警务的细节。该系统利用滑雪场的面部识别和火车上的追踪，可以追踪任何人并建立“综合档案”，让外国人无处藏身。

body.en:
A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."

When a cybersecurity researcher known by the pseudonym NetAskari recently clicked on a tab labeled "Inquiry for journalist files" on an unsecured Chinese web dashboard, he expected to see a jumble of auto-generated mock data.

Instead, familiar faces popped up on the screen. It was a comprehensive database of almost every foreign journalist based in Beijing around 2021, including official passport photos taken at the entry/exit bureau, private cellphone numbers, visa details and dates of birth. He also found his own exact personal information lying dormant on this Chinese police watch list.

"It was more interesting than shocking," NetAskari told DW. "When you work as a journalist in China , you basically assume you are always on their radar. But what surprised me was simply how easy it was to access this highly sensitive system."

What NetAskari had stumbled upon is part modern China's emerging system of "holographic profiles."

He had unwittingly accessed a demonstration version of a remote tracking system designed for the Public Security Bureau in Zhangjiakou, the Hebei province city that hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics.

Though it was only a test panel, it was populated with real datasets, clearly outlining the trajectory of China's state surveillance machine, which is rapidly evolving from a network of simple street cameras into a data-fused, 24/7, predictive social control behemoth.

For years, China has operated the world's most extensive CCTV network. A massive initiative known as the "Xueliang" (Bright Eyes) project aims to merge these isolated islands of surveillance spread across the country.

But the data on the Zhangjiakou police dashboard shows the granular detail with which authorities can track an individual.

This system no longer relies solely on police cameras on street corners; it accurately records the specific train carriage and seat number a target occupies when arriving from Beijing or Shanghai, for example.

It even synchronizes photos taken by facial-recognition ticket gates at local ski resorts directly into its tracking mechanism. The movements of the researcher's acquaintances who recently skied in Zhangjiakou were precisely flagged and mapped out with detailed trajectories in the system.

"The idea is simply to process as much data as possible from as many sensors as possible in real time," the researcher noted.

The system logs daily behaviors like gasoline consumption, regular shopping locations and whether an individual frequently visits "petition areas."

body.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声透露了中国新型高科技警务的细节。从滑雪场面部识别到火车座位，该系统可以跟踪任何人并编制“整体档案”。 当一位化名 NetAskari 的网络安全研究人员最近点击一个不安全的中文网络仪表板上标有“查询记者档案”的选项卡时，他预计会看到一堆自动生成的模拟数据。 取而代之的是，熟悉的面孔出现在屏幕上。这是一个综合数据库，包含 2021 年左右驻京的几乎所有外国记者，包括在出入境局拍摄的官方护照照片、私人手机号码、签证详细信息和出生日期。他还发现自己的确切个人信息隐藏在这份中国警方的监视名单上。 “这比令人震惊更有趣，”内特阿斯卡里告诉德国之声。 “当你在中国担任记者时，你基本上会认为你总是在他们的监视范围内。但令我惊讶的是访问这个高度敏感的系统是多么容易。” NetAskari 偶然发现的是现代中国新兴的“全息轮廓”系统的一部分。 他无意中访问了为主办 2022 年冬季奥运会的河北省张家口市公安局设计的远程跟踪系统演示版本。 虽然它只是一个测试面板，但它填充了真实的数据集，清楚地概述了中国国家监控机器的轨迹，该机器正在从简单的街道摄像头网络迅速演变为数据融合的、24/7、预测性的社会控制庞然大物。 多年来，中国运营着世界上最广泛的闭路电视网络。一项名为“雪亮”（明亮的眼睛）项目的大规模倡议旨在合并这些分布在全国各地的监视孤岛。 但张家口警方仪表板上的数据显示了当局可以追踪个人的详细信息。 该系统不再仅仅依赖于街角的警察摄像头；例如，它可以准确记录目标从北京或上海抵达时所乘坐的具体火车车厢和座位号。 它甚至将当地滑雪场的面部识别检票口拍摄的照片直接同步到其跟踪机制中。研究人员最近在张家口滑雪的熟人的动作被精确标记，并在系统中绘制出详细的轨迹。 研究人员指出：“这个想法只是实时处理来自尽可能多的传感器的尽可能多的数据。” 该系统会记录日常行为，例如汽油消耗、常规购物地点以及个人是否经常访问“请愿区”。 这种大规模的数据融合工作......

reflection.en: The news of pervasive high-tech surveillance highlights the vulnerability of individuals when state power becomes absolute. Proverbs 28:15 reminds us that unchecked authority can be like a dangerous predator to a helpless populace. It calls us to reflect on the importance of freedom and the dignity of every person, even in the face of overwhelming systems.
reflection.zh: 普遍存在的高科技监控新闻凸显了当国家权力变得绝对时，个人所面临的脆弱性。箴言28:15提醒我们，不受约束的权力对无助的民众来说，可能像危险的捕食者。它呼吁我们反思自由的重要性以及每个人的尊严，即使面对压倒性的系统。

verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: 'I shouted run': Witness recalls moment of China's worst mine disaster in years
title.zh: “我大喊快跑”：目击者回忆中国多年来最严重矿难发生瞬间

summary.en: A recent mining accident in China has been described as the country's deadliest since 2009, resulting in a significant loss of life. A witness recalled shouting for people to run during the incident.
summary.zh: 中国最近发生的一起矿难被描述为自2009年以来该国最致命的事故，造成了重大人员伤亡。一名目击者回忆在事故发生时曾大喊让人快跑。

body.en:
As emergency rescuers undertook a major rescue operation after Saturday's mining accident that killed at least 82 people in northern China, a wounded survivor said he heard no sound but smelled sulphur when the explosion happened.

"I didn't hear any sound at all, but then a cloud of smoke appeared," miner Wang Yong said.

"When I smelled it, it was the smell of sulphur like when people set off firecrackers. When the smoke came down, I shouted for people to run," he said.

"After more than an hour, I came to on my own, and then I woke up the person next to me" and got out, he told Chinese broadcaster CCTV.

The blast at the Liushenyu shaft in Shanxi province was the country's worst mining disaster in nearly two decades, with 247 workers underground at the time, according to Chinese media.

Hundreds of rescuers have rushed to the site, with medical teams taking 128 people to the hospital as of Saturday evening (local time), loaded into ambulances and carried on stretchers. Two people still remain missing.

Agence France-Presse journalists saw police blocking the road leading to the mine late Saturday, allowing only authorised vehicles to enter.

Helmeted rescuers took turns descending into the shaft overnight to look for the two missing workers, state media reported.

"As long as there is hope, we will make every possible effort," one rescuer told Xinhua news agency.

Chinese authorities launched an investigation into the blast, the worst since 2009 when 108 people were killed in a mine explosion in northeastern Heilongjiang province.

Preliminary findings showed the company operating the mine had committed "serious illegal violations", authorities told a press conference.

"Those found responsible will be severely punished in accordance with laws and regulations," they added.

A person "responsible for" the company involved had been "placed under control in accordance with the law", Xinhua reported.

The State Council, China's cabinet, ordered nationwide "tough crackdowns on illegal and unlawful activities", including the falsification of safety data, unclear headcounts of underground workers and illegal contracting.

Shanxi, one of China's poorer provinces, is the centre of the country's coal-mining industry.

Mine safety in China has improved in recent decades, but accidents still occur in an industry where safety protocols are often lax and regulations are vague.

In 2023, a collapse at an open-pit coal mine in the northern Inner Mongolia region killed 53 people.

title.en: Can the Quad stay relevant to boost Indo-Pacific security?
title.zh: 四方安全对话能否保持相关性以促进印太安全？

summary.en: Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.

body.en:
Foreign ministers from the United States, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.

Foreign ministers from the United States , India, Japan and Australia — the four nations that make up the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, better known as the Quad — are set to meet in New Delhi over three days startng Sunday to discuss Indo-Pacific security, energy supplies and emerging technologies.

The meeting comes as China continues to test geopolitical and security boundaries in the region.

But it's another issue, which is not on the agenda, that looms large over the gathering: how to keep the alliance alive and relevant in an ever more challenging geopolitical landscape and an increasingly assertive China .

The Quad, which unites the four nations in seeking a Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP), has not had a meeting of national leaders since 2024, when then-President Joe Biden hosted his counterparts in Wilmington, Delaware.

India was meant to host the next annual meeting in the latter part of 2025, but that never materialized amid tensions between India and the new administration of President Donald Trump .

Trump has imposed tariffs and punitive duties on Indian imports to the US, straining ties with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The US president further antagonized New Delhi by claiming to have mediated a settlement to border clashes between India and Pakistan in May last year . The US president was also critical of India purchasing Russian military equipment .

One year on, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is heading the US delegation to India, is tasked with smoothing ruffled diplomatic feathers. With Trump's attention apparently focused on the war in the Middle East and, potentially, Cuba , Rubio's mission could be a challenging one.

"The US, Japan and Australia already had an important and effective trilateral security arrangement, but the whole purpose of the Quad was to bring India in as another power to give it more influence and reach," said James Brown, a professor of international relations at the Tokyo campus of Temple University.

"Unfortunately, this US administration does not seem to have grasped that or valued India's presence as an ally, which has badly alienated Modi," he told DW.

Japan and Australia have made efforts to keep the four-way alliance intact and functioning, with Brown suggesting that the Quad might actually benefit from the US being represented by Rubio, rather than Trump, in India.

body.en:
From regional Queensland to outer Melbourne, Defence sites across Australia are at the centre of a growing legal and environmental battle over PFAS 'forever chemicals' linked to the manufacturing company 3M.

The Labor government will seek $2 billion in damages in a legal case against 3M, which is considered the largest legal claim ever brought by the government.

"We are taking on 3M on behalf of the Australian people and the Australians that are affected," Assistant Defence Minister Peter Khalil said.

"Today's announcement demonstrates that this government will stand up for Australians and hold big companies to account."

PFAS refers to a large group of synthetic chemicals used worldwide in manufacturing since the 1950s for water resistance.

Their toxicity was recognised in recent decades, with PFOS, PFOA, and PFHxS identified as the most harmful. Although these substances were banned in Australia in 2025, their continued use in legacy fire-fighting practices still causes problems.

"3M has never manufactured PFAS in Australia and ceased sales of the products at issue in Australia around two decades ago," they said.

"Despite this, the Department of Defence continued to use PFAS-containing fire-fighting foams for nearly two decades longer, as noted in a recent legislative committee report.

The foams are no longer used by defence, but it says it has spent $1.3 billion removing them from 28 contaminated sites across the country and surrounding areas where locals have been impacted, and compensating affected people.

On its website, the Department of Defence lists 28 PFAS management sites that are "being investigated and managed". The department confirmed these are the sites key to the case against 3M.

The sites are located in every state and territory, with the majority located in NSW, Queensland, and Western Australia.

The ACT's base in Jervis Bay has been impacted, as well as three sites in the NT — the RAAF base Tindal, RAAF Base Darwin and Robertson Barracks.

Some of these are near population centres that have had groundwater impacted by PFAS chemicals. As a result of PFAS use at the Williamtown base, outside the Newcastle area, around 500 Williamtown residents signed up to the class action against the Department of Defence.

Following the announcement of the Williamtown class action, two others were also announced at other contaminated sites around Australia; one in Oakey, QLD, the other in Katherine, NT.

body.en:
A group of Australian residents and one New Zealander have had their quarantine period extended after being caught up in a deadly hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship.

Health Minister Mark Butler announced on Thursday the six people who have been in isolation at the Centre for National Resilience in Western Australia since mid-May will remain there for the full 42-day quarantine period, as recommended by Australian health officials and the World Health Organization.

"The passengers have been informed about the advice and the decision of government," Butler told reporters in Canberra.

"I'm happy to say they remain well, they've only been tested again in the last 24 or 36 hours or so and all six have again tested negative."

An order, made under the Biosecurity Act, has remained in place for three weeks and was extended ahead of its expiry date of 5 June.

A crew member from the cruise ship in the Netherlands tested positive, along with a passenger in Spain.

This confirmed the risk of transmission after disembarkation has not passed, Butler said.

Earlier in May, a cluster of cruise ship passengers were reported to have contracted severe respiratory illnesses after it departed Argentina on 1 April.

body.en:
United States manufacturing firm 3M has said it will fight a $2 billion legal case brought against it by the Australian government over its products containing so-called 'forever chemicals'.

At a press conference on Thursday, Attorney-General Michelle Rowland and Assistant Defence Minister Peter Khalil announced Australia will seek the enormous fee in damages against 3M — the largest legal claim ever brought by a government.

The US multinational is accused of withholding internal test data showing its fire-fighting foam had significant adverse environmental impacts.

"The Commonwealth is seeking more than $2 billion in damages to recover significant past and future expenses incurred in investigating and managing contamination resulting from the historical storage and use of this foam," Rowland told reporters.

"Our position is that 3M withheld a range of information and misrepresented the effects of this substance."

The company was the historical primary manufacturer of aqueous film-forming foams (AFFF), such as their Lightwater foam line.

The products relied heavily on the addition of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), which do not break down and accumulate in the environment and in human bodies. They have been linked to an increased risk of cancer as well as immune, hormonal, and birth issues .

PFAS is a vast family of synthetic chemicals that have been used globally in manufacturing for their water-resistant properties since the 1950s.

However, their toxic nature was not fully understood until recent decades, with PFOS, PFOA and PFHxS identified as the most toxic. These were specifically banned in Australia in 2025, but their use in legacy fire-fighting practices continues to cause issues.

Defence no longer uses the foams but says it has spent $1.3 billion removing them from 28 contaminated sites across the country and the surrounding areas where locals have been impacted, and compensating people affected by them.

"We are taking on 3M on behalf of the Australian people and the Australians that are affected," Khalil said. "Today's announcement demonstrates that this government will stand up for Australians and hold big companies to account."

Seven water treatment plants have had to be operated near Defence sites to stem the spread of these chemicals as they leach into the surroundings.

In a statement to SBS News, the company said that it was aware of the government's claims.

body.en:
Labor will move forward with tax changes impacting businesses and property investors as it prepares to introduce an overall framework for the reforms.

Treasurer Jim Chalmers introduced a landmark bill to parliament on Thursday that includes changes to capital gains tax (CGT) and negative gearing, as well as a $250-a-year tax rebate for workers.

"This is a bill for workers, for first home buyers and for future generations," he told the House of Representatives.

"It will help ensure that aspiration and opportunity are the birthright of every Australian and not just some."

Labor has argued the changes will help young people who have been locked out of the housing market by a system that taxes income earned from labour at a higher rate than income derived from investments, including property purchases.

But the planned axing of a 50 per cent CGT discount — in place since 1999 — has drawn criticism, including from many business groups that fear it will discourage investment.

West Australian Premier Roger Cook has become the second Labor state leader, following NSW's Chris Minns, to raise concerns about the tax changes, suggesting the capital gains shift could deter foreign firms from spending money on fledgling mining projects.

Responding to the criticism from Cook, whose state was crucial to Labor's federal election wins, Housing Minister Clare O'Neil said there would always be opposition to anything "big and difficult".

While the majority of economists and business groups have acknowledged the need for tax reform, the government has taken flak for replacing the capital gains discount with an inflation-adjusted system.

It would apply to all asset sales, including investments in shares and businesses.

The government has flagged a likely carve-out for startups, which have low initial costs but the potential for rapid growth, and is consulting with industry groups on other changes.

On Wednesday, Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry chief executive Andrew McKellar called on Labor to confine the tax overhaul to housing.

"That will be bad for productivity. That will be bad for competitiveness. It will be bad for the future growth of the Australian economy," he said.

title.en: IS-linked woman who returned to Australia last year charged with terrorism offences
title.zh: 去年返回澳大利亚的与伊斯兰国有关的妇女被指控犯有恐怖主义罪

summary.en: The woman has been charged with entering and remaining in a declared conflict zone and being a member of a terrorist organisation.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A woman who returned to Australia in September has been charged with terrorism offences, according to the Australian Federal Police (AFP).

A 34-year-old woman is expected to face Melbourne Magistrate's Court on Thursday afternoon. She faces charges of entering and remaining in a declared conflict zone and being a member of a terrorist organisation.

The woman had been detained by Kurdish forces in March 2019 and held in Syria's al-Hawl camp with other family members. She returned to Australia from Lebanon with another woman on 26 September, AFP deputy commissioner of national security investigations Hilda Sirec told a media briefing.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

They were not part of the cohort of women and children linked to the self-proclaimed Islamic State group (IS) who returned to Australia this month from the al-Roj camp, also located in Syria.

Two such groups have returned to Australia this month after years in the al-Roj camp.

The second group arrived in Sydney and Melbourne on Tuesday, but no arrests were made on arrival.

Three women from the first cohort were arrested after landing in Sydney and Melbourne. Two were charged with crimes against humanity, including slavery. The third woman was charged with a terrorism-related crime.

The arrests fall under Operation Kurrajong, a coordinated operation between federal, state and territory counter-terrorism police, and the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation, investigating Australians alleged to have travelled to Syria and Iraq during the rise of the IS group.

"It is important to note that a period of time without charges being laid is not an indicator that investigations have ceased," Sirec said on Thursday.

"Investigations are continuing into all the recent adult female returnees from Syrian camps."

"Anyone who would like to provide information about the investigation is encouraged to call the National Security Hotline on 1800 123 400."

Victoria Police deputy commissioner Libby Murphy said that community safety remains a top priority.

"We want to reassure the community that we are doing everything we can to ensure there is no risk to the Victorian community from those returning from conflict areas."
